pages.title: The Federation
pages.text: The $(l)Federation$() is what a constellation of Charter colonies calls itself when they decide to coordinate without asking the Charter.$(br2)Cargo runs. Joint defence. Shared smelters. The Federation is the practical answer to the Charter's slowness.

It is not, strictly, a separate government. The Charter still signs the dockets. The Charter still audits the books. The Federation is a $(o)Foreman's club$() — senior engineers from the major colonies who meet, drink, and agree on standards the Charter is too slow to write.$(br2)Some say the Federation is the Charter's future. Some say it is the Charter's mistake.
The $(l)Brass Hall$() is where the Federation meets. It is not on any Charter map. The senior Foreman of every full Federation colony knows where it is. They do not write it down.
